invariants: Preserve the source operation family and comparable arithmetic workload.

scope.details: Sampled variations preserve source operations, prerequisites, response format and workload.

grading.details: 442 native grading checks pass, including every option classification and rejection of stale counterfactual answers. Fields are radio-only.

packaging.details: Relocation, deterministic replay, boundary rejection and exact dependency versions pass. Package bytes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant counterfactuals behave correctly, but conditional answer-bank cues bypass the intended reasoning in every tested easy profile and survive UI shuffling.
